findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 57 mm is observed in the tail of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in one node at station 10 and two nodes at station 11p. No other evident metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH0 (no invasion of the common hepatic artery)
DU0 (no invasion of the duodenum)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV0 (no invasion of the portal vein)
A0 (no invasion of the arterial branches)
PL0 (no invasion of the pancreatic lymphatic vessels)
OO1 (obstruction of the pancreatic duct)

Task 2: Determine the T classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size of the tumor (57 mm), it is classified as T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer in the tail are:
- Station 10 (left gastric artery lymph nodes)
- Station 11p (common hepatic artery lymph nodes)

Metastatic lymph nodes are observed in:
- Station 10 (1 node)
- Station 11p (2 nodes)

The regional lymph nodes involved are stations 10 and 11p. Counting only the metastatic lymph nodes within these regional stations, there are 3 involved regional nodes.

N classification: N1b

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

No distant metastases are observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

No criteria for Borderline Resectable (BR) or Unresectable (UR) are met, so the classification is Resectable (R).

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

T classification: T3
N classification: N1b
M classification: M0

Based on the T classification, the tumor is classified as T3. Based on the N classification, the lymph node involvement is classified as N1b. Based on the M classification, there are no distant metastases. Therefore, the overall stage is Stage IIA.
